description:
Amendment 2 - New Site Visit# 2 scheduled, updating Questions Close date, updating RFP Close date  

  -New Site Visit# 2 is now scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 8:30 am CST.   Please  meet up  at the  Fermilab Badge Office  and then the site visit at Wilson Hall.  Everyone is required to meet up at the Fermilab Badge Office for the pre-brief of the project.  Follow the instructions in Exhibit O to apply for access to the site.  Please email the Procurement Specialist at ginakern@fnal.gov with the information listed in the RFP regarding the Site Visit prior to attending.  This includes if you already have site access.  Please arrive at least 5-10 minutes early as the Site Visit will start on time. 

  -New Questions Close Date is now November 24, 2026 at 5:00 pm CST.  All questions must be submitted in writing only.  Send all questions, referencing the RFP# in the subject line to ginakern@fnal.gov.  

  -New Closing Date for the Request for Proposal (RFP) is now December 9, 2026 at 3:00 pm CST.  Please submit your proposal with all required documents to ginakern@fnal.gov.  

 ************************************************************************************************************************* 

 Fermilab has a new requirement for Wilson Hall Floor 16 Electric and Elevator Machine Rooms Fire Rating and Mechanical Upgrade located at Batavia, IL. 

  

 Site visit is scheduled for November 4, 2026 at 8:30 am CST. 

  

 Request for Proposal Closes on November 17, 2026 at 3:00 pm CST.
